title: On Turan Type inequality for Quaternionic Canonical Generalized Polynomials
summary: This paper establishes Turán-type inequalities for quaternionic canonical generalized polynomials with all zeros in the closed unit ball of radius $k \geq 1$. We extend the classical inequality due to Govil from the complex setting to the quaternionic framework. We prove that for certain classes of polynomials, the inequality \[\|P'\| \geq \frac{n}{1+k^n}\|P\|\] holds for all $k \geq 1$, where $n$ is the degree of the polynomial.
